entry.name: int
entry.description: int can store and output any given integer number.

arguments.name: initial-value
arguments.digest: Sets an initial value to be stored
arguments.description: Sets an initial value to be stored in. If there is no argument, the initial value is 0. An int argument by itself, without the word, is another way of creating and initializing anobject. Float values are converted to integers.
